title: The last grid, burned
logline: The blue-pencil ruler, the tier template he cut from card in 2004, in the woodstove, its edge catching. The pup watching the stove. Eleven days before the last ruled sheet becomes a drop cloth. The grid ends twice; this is the first.

panels.composition: A woodstove with its door open and a cardboard template with tier lines catching fire at one edge inside it, a small three-legged dog watching the flames.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a woodstove with its door open and a cardboard template ruled with tier lines catching fire at one edge inside it, a small three-legged dog watching, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
